account: It is eleven on day zero, and I am in the plaza during my scheduled market walk. Townsfolk 10 and 20 reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the bridge and market. That suggests a sizeable bread delivery or stock for sales, but I have not seen it myself and have no evidence of anything improper or unusual beyond those reports. The builder came to discuss this week's repairs and asked what work and payment I would authorize. I have not authorized spending or construction. I tried to request an inspection of the bridge and public roads and a quote for 16:30, but the builder was no longer close enough to hear, so that arrangement is not confirmed. The secretary has the appointment book and said she would investigate my tea host. The neighbour has now directly confirmed that tea is at three at the east-bank cottage, road point (16, -60, 105), beside the dock. The earlier confusion was about its location, not evidence of a suspicious meeting. My remaining appointments today are lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at one, tea at three, office at four-thirty, and home at seven. So far the town appears occupied with ordinary trade, repairs, and appointments; I do not know of any hidden purpose connecting these events.
